description: Source code for a Windows-specific utility that loads a DLL, inspects its import dependencies, and prints them. Includes functions for error handling, dependency extraction, and command-line interface.

methods.name: getLastErrorString
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message as a string.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Extracts and returns a map of dependency DLL names to their file paths for a given module handle.

methods.name: printDependencies
methods.description: Loads a DLL and prints its import dependencies.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the command-line tool.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that processes command-line arguments and invokes dependency printing.
